text_to_speech: Hello astronomers! In this tutorial  I will show you how to use the PLUS   guide rings and connect them to all  the other PLUS elements, let's start! As you can see, the PLUS guide rings comes in two  different sizes but both of them has the same   threaded holes to connect to other PLUS elements.  Let's see how. If you have a Vixen style PLUS   dovetail bar, you can connect them with two M6  screws this way. Instead, if you have the PLUS   Losmandy style dovetail bar, you can connect them  with two M6 screws. And if you want to have the   PLUS guide ring on top of the PLUS support ring,  you can fix this way, always by using two M6 screws. And if you want to connect the PLUS guide ring on  top of your EAGLE, you have to take the additional   plate together with the provided M5 screw and  then connect it directly on top of your EAGLE.

youtube_description: PLUS guide rings are available in different sizes and they allow you to install a guide telescope in parallel to the main one. PLUS guide rings are are made with high mechanical precision (built with CNC machines from aluminum block) and they're designed for an easy connection to other PLUS mechanical elements such Vixen or Losmandy style dovetail bars or support rings. By connecting them to other PLUS elements with 2 screws, you can avoid flexures that are a common problem in astrophotography. You can also install the PLUS guide rings directly above the EAGLE.
